page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Above the text: the running head "PARS PRIMA." and the page number 155. A small figure at the top right, outside the text block, is noted below. The left edge of the scan carries the facing page's edge and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: ram confumerent ;illi veró , Dauid inquam & qui ex familia eius,vrgerent minifterium illud, & ordinem humanum fuum in procurando rerum facrarum ordine religiosè occuparent. Sic videmus Pfalres à Dauide fuiffe Ecclefiæ datos;& ordines minifteriį facri, adhibito Pro-phetarum & fanctorū Dei virorum confilio,di-stributos : vt difertis verbis auctor libri Chro-nicorum aliquoties confirmauit.

Reftat locus tertius,de stabilimento istius or-dinis: quod Prophera innuit perpaucis verbis, dicens hæc folia illic confidere. priùs quidem, vbi de fidelibus Ecclefiæ membrisactum eft , dixit tribus ascendere illuc ad testimonium Iehouæ: nunc verò agens de diuino ordine , aut rebus diuinis ministrante ; qui Dei auctoritate infti-tutus est in Ecclefia eius , dicit Prophetaillo in loco confidere. Id autem significare videtur Psalres confidendi verbo, Deu auctorem istius ordinis in Ecclefia sua , tum stabiliuisse ordi-nem illu, tum verò actiones illius ordinis præ-sentia sua direxisse & firmauisse ad gloriam suam.Confidentenim,qui in pace funt,aut qui immoti funt ab aduersis rebus:Confident præ-tereà,qui maturé coufilia ineunt, vt benè rebus gerendis præsint[?] ac salutariter. Cùm itaque hi throni dicuntur confidere , partim de pace & firmamento illorum prouisum esse à Deo in-telligimus,partimque res iufto ordine confilio: que prouisas,curatas,gestas,tanquam à sapien-tibus

page.notes: Printed as "Pfalres" (possibly for "Pfalmes"); left as printed. "præsint" is uncertain: the abbreviation over the p is hard to read, so it is marked [?]. The top-right marginal figure reads as "99", unclear, so it is not transcribed as a note. Long s is normalised to plain s. The left-edge marks and fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted. A stray tick stands before "telligimus" and is ignored.
